value.rationale: For minimum decycling placements on the canonical cuboctahedral graph, optimal configurations are compact cube-spanning walks. The sharp six-step reversible local bound, three orbit-dependent distance profiles, and persistence of the same 144 extremal pairs despite an 83-percent edge increase under nonlocal moves quantify genuine mobility and robustness beyond the previously enumerated set count. Canonical small-cube baseline for larger-dimensional sampling and constrained-reconfiguration problems.
